why: A (universes at 0) contains B's statement in a stronger form: subDegIndex_eq_of_submanifoldTangent_eq gives d_{M₁}(y) = d_{M₂}(y) from T_yM₁ = T_yM₂ for smooth submanifolds with tame induced structures, without B's hypotheses that Y is tame and that M₁, M₂ have the same dimension. A_to_B applies that conjunct: B's dMB is the project's subDegIndex of the same sub-M-polyfold (dif_pos plus proof irrelevance), and IsSubmanifoldOfDim gives IsSmoothSubmanifold. A also has the chart formula d_M(y) = dim(T_yM / T_yM ∩ E_y) and the chart form of the lemma (lemma_9_3_7 has the text's hypotheses, tangent equality read in one chart). B states none of these, and it cannot give them, because its hypotheses (P.IsTame, equal dimension) are missing. So B_to_A does not use B. It re-proves the four statements outright, as copies of the project's proofs from unbanned lemmas (degIndex_eq_quotDim_of_isTame, subPolyfold_isChart, tangentSpace_eq_coe_submodule, chartVec_image_submanifoldTangent). The meaningful relation is A ⇒ B with A stronger: the dropped hypotheses are unused, as the project's docstring says.
overlap: B_to_A: 615 shared project theorems. All are the infrastructure the copied proofs share with the originals: degIndex_eq_quotDim_of_isTame (2021 Prop 2.5.6 (13)), subPolyfold_isChart / subChart, SubData.mem_shrink / isScRetract_image, tangentSpace_eq_coe_submodule, chartVec_image_submanifoldTangent, proposition_4_15_1, and their M-polyfold / sc-calculus dependencies. None of the banned theorems is used (rt_check OK). A_to_B uses only the hypothesis and dMB unfolding.
